RSS Excludes Pakistan, Bangladesh, Turkey from 100-Year Bash!
RSS Excludes Key Nations from Centennial Bash! RSS celebrations Delhi, diplomatic relations South Asia, India Pakistan tensions
BREAKING NEWS
RSS will not INVITE diplomats from Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Turkey to its 100-year celebrations, scheduled for August 26–28 in New Delhi.
— Megh Updates (@MeghUpdates)
[August 7, 2025]
- YOU MAY ALSO LIKE TO WATCH THIS TRENDING STORY ON YOUTUBE. Waverly Hills Hospital's Horror Story: The Most Haunted Room 502
BREAKING NEWS
The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has announced that it will not invite diplomats from Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Turkey to its 100-year celebrations. Scheduled for August 26–28 in New Delhi, this gathering is expected to attract significant attention from various sectors. The decision to exclude these nations’ diplomats has sparked discussions and debates across social and mainstream media.
RSS Will Not INVITE Diplomats from Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Turkey
This move by the RSS has raised eyebrows, especially considering the historical and political context surrounding India’s relations with these countries. The absence of diplomats from Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Turkey at such a prominent event could indicate shifting diplomatic ties and priorities within the region. Many analysts are eager to see how this decision will impact future interactions and collaborations.
Scheduled for August 26–28 in New Delhi
The 100-year celebrations are set to be a landmark event for the RSS, reflecting a century of its influence in India. With so much at stake, the decision to limit invitations could serve as a statement of the organization’s current stance on international diplomacy. As the date approaches, all eyes will be on New Delhi to see how this situation unfolds. For more insights, check out the full story by Megh Updates.
